results.title: Databricks Launches Native Genie Plugins for Four AI Agents – Unite.AI
results.content:
Databricks had already connected Genie to outside assistants before this launch. A September 22, 2026 Genie One MCP announcement described governed context for assistants and coding agents over Model Context Protocol (MCP), a protocol for connecting AI agents to external tools. The new plugins add native interfaces within the named products while using the same context layer.

## How Genie Supplies Business Context [...] Databricks launched native Genie plugins on November 11, 2026, for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. The integrations give all four agents governed access to business context held in Databricks, while other compatible agents can still connect through the Genie One MCP server. [...] Answer quality also depends on the data estate behind the ontology. Databricks’ September 1, 2026 implementation guide says Genie Ontology works on day one, but higher accuracy depends on clean data, consistent entity records, useful metadata, governed metric definitions, certified assets and continuing evaluation. It recommends beginning with one domain and strengthening its definitions, sources, governance and evaluation before expanding.

## Recent developments
- **Always-On Genie & Agentic AI Launch:** In November 2026, Databricks announced the second generation of Genie, transforming it into an always-on, autonomous agent for enterprise work capable of taking ownership of goals, delegating to subagents, and utilizing a new inbox feature [1, 7].
- **Genie Ecosystem Expansion:** Databricks made Genie Ontology generally available, launched Genie Search, and introduced native Genie plugins for major AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, and Grok Bot) to provide governed business context [6, 7]. 
- **Major European Investments:** Databricks committed approximately $3 billion across Europe and the Middle East over the next three years—including over $500 million in the Netherlands—to accelerate enterprise data and AI adoption alongside Lakebase, Genie, and Unity Gateway [1, 2].
- **Row Zero Acquisition Integration:** Following its September 2026 acquisition of Row Zero, Databricks integrated live, governed spreadsheets into Genie [2].

## Talking points
- How enterprises are adopting the new always-on, autonomous capabilities of Genie for complex, multi-step workflows.
- Implementation strategies for Genie Ontology and Genie Search to unify structured and unstructured data estates securely.
- Integration workflows utilizing the newly launched native Genie plugins for third-party AI agents like ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, and Grok Bot [6].
- Deployment plans for the recently announced $3 billion regional investment pipeline across Europe and the Middle East [2].

## Open questions
- How quickly are enterprise customers transitioning from passive querying to trusting autonomous, always-on Genie agents with multi-step operational workflows?
- What are the primary milestones and timeline for Databricks' anticipated public market entry/IPO strategy?
- How is the integration of recent acquisitions like Row Zero and Panther Labs scaling within the core lakehouse platform?
